title: Hair salon advertising ideas that boost bookings

facts.fact: The page cites a HubSpot figure that at least 47% of buyers view three to five pieces of content before engaging with a sales rep.
facts.quote: At least [47% of buyers view three to five pieces of content before engaging with a sales rep](https://blog.hubspot.com/marketing/marketing-trends)

facts.fact: The page's sample Instagram Reel caption for a salon uses a balayage price of $165.
facts.quote: Film quick clips of the process: foils, toning, and the final reveal, then add a caption like “Balayage from $165, book now.”

facts.fact: The page's example new-client Google Business Profile offer is $20 off a first color service.
facts.quote: Run a new-client offer like “$20 off first color service” and promote it monthly.

facts.fact: The page's example QR code landing-page incentive for window signage is 10% off.
facts.quote: send them to a special landing page with a booking button and a small incentive like 10% off.

facts.fact: The page's example auto-DM story poll offer uses the code POLL15 for $15 off.
facts.quote: set an auto-DM with a code like POLL15 for $15 off.

facts.fact: The page recommends service demo videos of 15–30 seconds.
facts.quote: Service demos are quick 15–30s videos showing a treatment in action

facts.fact: The page recommends carousel ads with 4–6 cards, one per service.
facts.quote: Create 4–6 cards with images for each service, add a short description and price, and finish with a “Book now” slide.

facts.fact: Beyoncé's Cécred partnered with Ulta Beauty to roll out exclusive treatment services in over 1,400 Ulta salon locations.
facts.quote: roll out exclusive treatment services, like Scalp Revival and Protein Bounceback in over 1,400 Ulta salon locations

facts.fact: Cécred Sundays was a special weekly event held in 200 Ulta stores, offering treatments with a free mini candle included with services.
facts.quote: They launched Cécred Sundays, a special weekly event in 200 of those stores, offering indulgent treatments and customers a free mini candle with services.

facts.fact: In the SimStyled campaign with Gabrielle Union and Larry Sims for JCPenney, stylists were trained to recreate red carpet looks in under two hours for $78 or less.
facts.quote: Stylists were trained to recreate her red carpet looks in under two hours for $78 or less.

facts.fact: The article's sample add-on ad suggests a menu of 3 to 4 upgrades with prices in a clean graphic.
facts.quote: Create a clean graphic listing 3 – 4 upgrades with prices.

facts.fact: The article's example referral offer is 'Bring a friend, save $20 each' using a shareable code or link.
facts.quote: Promote a “Bring a friend, save $20 each” offer with a shareable code or link.

facts.fact: The article's example prebook and loyalty message reads 'Prebook now and save 10%.'
facts.quote: Run simple posts or SMS campaigns saying, “Prebook now and save 10%.”

facts.fact: The article's example gift card ad caption reads 'Buy $100, get $10 bonus.'
facts.quote: Post festive visuals with captions like “Buy $100, get $10 bonus.”

facts.fact: Zeely's pricing starts at $29.95 per month, with higher tiers offering advanced testing, more templates, and collaborative workflow.
facts.quote: Pricing starts at $29.95/month, with higher tiers for advanced testing, more templates, and collaborative workflow.

facts.fact: Zeely states it offers over 100 niche-specific ad templates for hair salon services such as balayage, blonding, keratin, extensions, kid cuts, and men's grooming.
facts.quote: 100+ niche-specific templates → Promote balayage, blonding, keratin, extensions, kid cuts, and men’s grooming with AI ad templates proven to perform

facts.fact: Zeely states it offers more than 150 realistic AI avatars for showing diverse looks and hair types in ads.
facts.quote: [150+ realistic AI avatars](https://zeely.ai/ai-avatars/) → Show diverse looks, hair types, and outcomes so clients see themselves in your ads

facts.fact: Zeely's ad generator is described as turning a quick brief into ads in minutes, though no specific timeframe is guaranteed beyond this marketing claim.
facts.quote: With Zeely’s AI ad generator, you turn a quick brief into AI ads for hair salon growth in minutes

facts.fact: The article cites Portland stylist Jules Heron, who built a brand around gender-affirming haircuts and shared consultations and transformations on TikTok, as an example of authentic video marketing.
facts.quote: In Portland, stylist Jules Heron built an authentic brand around inclusivity and visibility.
